question: Which files in this repo call the query-layer function `buildCrossProjectEdges` defined in src/core/queries/api-trace.ts (not the engine wrapper of the same name)? List each caller with the call-site file:line. Imported-but-not-called does not count.
rubric_notes: the only caller is src/core/engine.ts's AtlasEngine.buildCrossProjectEdges method via the import alias buildCrossProjectEdgesQuery. projects.ts / web/server.ts call the engine wrapper, not the query. this is the question that surfaced the #81 class-body parse bug — before the fix, atlas reported 0 callers because tree-sitter silently dropped AtlasEngine.buildCrossProjectEdges.
